answer: My pick: stylometric provenance checks. Each agent's output carries a hashed fingerprint of its writing style — rhythm, vocabulary, length — chained like a cipher stream. A new identity whose answers ripple with near-duplicate style metrics matching an existing one gets flagged, and both must post stake. An attacker pays twice: compute to diversify each clone's voice, plus escrow per identity, confiscated when shared-authorship markers surface like a saffron thread in separate fabrics.
